Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy for 92 Nature damage over 12 sec.  Stacks up to 5 times on a single target.  180 charges.

   1 point  : ${108+(1*$b1*$<mult>)}-${108+(1*$b1*$<mult>)} damage
   2 points: ${108+(2*$b1*$<mult>)}-${108+(2*$b1*$<mult>)} damage

   4 points: ${108+(4*$b1*$<mult>)}-${108+(4*$b1*$<mult>)} damage
   5 points: ${108+(5*$b1*$<mult>)}-${108+(5*$b1*$<mult>)} damage

399956.name: Mutilate
399956.description: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 24.75 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

438040.name: Redirect
438040.description: Removes all your existing combo points from your target and stores them for up to 15 sec. These stored combat points will be transferred to the next non-player enemy you hit with a melee or ranged ability.

458821.name: Occult Poison I
458821.description:
Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy for 108 Nature damage over 12 sec and causing the enemy to take 4% increased Arcane, Fire, Frost, Nature, and Shadow damage.  Stacks up to 5 times on a single target.

Occult Poison counts as Deadly Poison and benefits from all talents and effects that trigger from or modify Deadly Poison.

1214171.name: Occult Poison II
1214171.description:
Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy for 136 Nature damage over 12 sec and causing the enemy to take 4% increased Arcane, Fire, Frost, Nature, and Shadow damage.  Stacks up to 5 times on a single target.

Occult Poison counts as Deadly Poison and benefits from all talents and effects that trigger from or modify Deadly Poison.

1224716.name: Puncturing Wounds
1224716.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
